doc: ratatoskr graph export (Urdr Task 17; storage §8.2): three tasks written through the hub, then exported from the command line to --out: entities.jsonl has them sorted by id, a second export of an unchanged store is byte for byte the same, and --project without --out is a usage error (exit 2) that writes nothing.

args: mkdir -p $ROOT/work/alpha && cd $ROOT/work/alpha && export GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1700000000 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1700000000 +0000' && git -c init.defaultBranch=main init -q && git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@example.invalid -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -q --allow-empty -m alpha
export LC_ALL=C; f=$ROOT/exp1/entities.jsonl; test "$(grep -c '"kind":"task"' $f)" -ge 3 && grep -o '^{"id":"[^"]*"' $f | sort -c
